title: The person's responses
description: The person's actions after `after` (stored `act` lines, which include `grant` and `deny` answers to the caller's requests), each batch up to a Send sorted by card number. `more` is true when `limit` cut the list, which it cuts in ledger order: read the rest with `after` set to the highest `seq` in `responses`. A wait that timed out answers `{ responses: [], head }`.

responses.description: The person's actions after `after`. Each batch, up to and ending with its Send, is sorted by card number: a note on a group at its lowest card, a note on or the layout of a whole container at the lowest card in it (first when it holds none), grant answers after the cards; acts on one card in the order made. A ✓ or ✗ on a question or an action carries `means`, the word it says there (`yes`, `no`, `done`).

reported.description: One stored `act` line as the agent reads it, plus `means` on a ✓ or ✗ whose card's kind gives it a word.

means.description: What the ✓ or ✗ means on its card's kind: `yes` (✓) or `no` (✗) on a question, `done` (✓) on an action. Left out wherever the act means itself, such as ✗ on an action or ✓ on a finding. Not stored in the ledger.
